result_producers.phase3/config_*.json: training run configuration (see the runs table)
result_producers.phase3/diag/*: stability diagnostic runs A to E (see the runs table)
result_producers.phase3/loss_log_*.csv: training logs of the runs in the runs table
result_producers.phase3/seeds/*: training logs of the seed runs

notes: Latent extraction is not bitwise reproducible (paper Sections 3.1 and 3.2), and kernels are non-deterministic, so a seed fixes data order and initialization but not the bits of a trained checkpoint.
